# DataModel

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- **Not creatable**: it cannot be created with `Instance.new`

The root of the instance tree, available as the global `game`. Every service is a child of it, and every service exists from startup, in a fixed order.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `EngineVersion` | `string` | — | read-only | The version of the engine that is running, as set in `project.toml`. |
| `LuauVersion` | `string` | — | read-only | The version of the Luau language runtime built into this engine. It is fixed for each engine release. |

## Methods

### `BindToClose(callback: () -> ())`

Registers a function to run while the game shuts down, for work that must finish before the process ends, such as saving. The functions have a limited time; when it runs out, shutdown continues whether they have finished or not. Stopping the game in the editor also runs them.

These functions are for the whole game. The open scene's `scene:BindToClose` functions run first, then these, in the order they were registered, each in its own thread. An error in one does not stop the others. A function registered by a scene's script is dropped without running when that scene closes; use `scene:BindToClose` for a scene.

### `BindToMessage(topic: string, callback: (...any) -> ())`

Binds a function that runs with a message's values each time a message is sent to `game` under `topic`. The binding belongs to the script that made it: one made by a scene's script is removed with its scene.

### `FindService(name: string): Instance?`

Returns the service with the given name, or nil if the name is not a service. It differs from `GetService` only in returning nil instead of raising an error.

### `GetService(name: string): Instance`

Returns the service with the given name. Every service exists from startup, and every call returns the same instance, an ordinary child of `game`. With a string literal, the result has the service's exact type; with a name computed at run time, it is typed as `Instance`. Raises an error for a name that is not a service.

### `SendMessage(topic: string, arguments: ...any)`

Sends a message to the game: every function bound to `topic` on `game` with `BindToMessage` runs with the message's values. The functions run deferred, in the order the messages were sent, each in its own thread. Use it for a scene to tell game-wide code something, as in `game:SendMessage("CoinCollected", 1)`.

The values are copied, as in `Scene:SendMessage`, and cannot include functions or instances. Messages stay on this machine.

### `Shutdown()`

Ends the game. The functions registered with `BindToClose` get their time to run, and then the process exits.

## Events

Signals are deferred: a handler runs at the next resumption point, not
inside the call that fired the signal.

### `Loaded()`

Fires once, after every entry script has run for the first time. A handler connected at the top level of an entry script still receives it. It passes no arguments.
